title: DEPICT: Scoring Text-to-Image Alignment by Answer Agreement
title_zh: DEPICT：通过回答一致性评估文本到图像的对齐度

paragraphs.en: Image-text alignment is a core problem in computer vision with applications in caption evaluation, hallucination detection, data curation, and the benchmarking of text-to-image (T2I) generators. As T2I models improve, benchmarking has become demanding, requiring metrics capable of finding a series of issues like missing objects, swapped attributes, miscounts, and ignored negations. Recent work addresses this by fine-tuning evaluators on preference data or by prompting a vision-language model, either holistically with the caption or with decomposed verification questions. However, existing approaches fall short: fine-tuned metrics remain bound to one backbone and training distribution; holistic metrics miss fine-grained details; and decomposed metrics rely on a fixed-YES assumption that penalizes faithful images whenever that assumption fails. In contrast, we propose Depict , a training-free metric that replaces fixed reference answers with expected agreement between image-based and caption-only answers, weighting questions by how decisively the caption determines them. By replacing fixed references, our agreement rule increases negation accuracy from 19% to 88%. To recover the context lost during decomposition, Depict merges this agreement score with a holistic score. We evaluate Depict on five benchmarks and eleven backbones from three model families and find that it surpasses all training-free metrics and exceeds fine-tuned evaluators on two out of three human-correlation benchmarks. 1 1 1 Code will be available for research purposes.

paragraphs.en: Image-text alignment evaluation is fundamental across vision-language tasks, including caption scoring ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) , vision-language models (VLM) hallucination detection ( Kogilathota et al., 2026 ) , data filtering ( Schuhmann et al., 2021 ; Gadre et al., 2023 ) , and, increasingly, evaluating text-to-image (T2I) generators ( Kamath et al., 2025 ; Ramos et al., 2026 ) and their reward signals ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Black et al., 2024 ) . As T2I models improve, the question has shifted from whether they can generate an image that matches a prompt to whether they can render every aspect of it faithfully, without dropping an object, swapping an attribute, miscounting, or ignoring a negation ( Labs et al., 2025 ; Chefer et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . An alignment metric must therefore correlate with human judgments on open-ended text, including these fine-grained errors ( Ku et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 图像与文本的对齐评估在各类视觉语言任务中至关重要，包括对图像描述进行评分（Hessel 等，2021）、检测视觉语言模型（VLM）的幻觉（Kogilathota 等，2026）、数据过滤（Schuhmann 等，2021；Gadre 等，2023），以及日益重要的文本到图像（T2I）生成器（Kamath 等，2025；Ramos 等，2026）及其奖励信号的评估（Xu 等，2023；Black 等，2024）。 随着 T2I 模型的性能提升，研究重点已从“模型能否生成与提示匹配的图像”转向“模型能否忠实地呈现图像的每一个细节，而不会出现遗漏物体、替换属性、计数错误或忽略否定词等问题”（Labs 等，2025；Chefer 等，2026；Zhao 等，2026）。 因此，对齐指标必须能够与人类对开放文本的判断相关联，包括对这些细微错误的识别（Ku 等，2024）。

paragraphs.en: Two families of evaluators have emerged. Fine-tuned metrics learn a scoring function from preference data ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Kirstain et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Marjit et al., 2026 ) , while training-free ones prompt an off-the-shelf VLM ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2023 ; Cho et al., 2024 ) . We focus on the training-free family due to a fundamental structural advantage: while fine-tuned evaluators remain bound to a specific architecture and the static distribution of their training data, training-free metrics naturally scale alongside foundation models, inheriting backbone advancements without task-specific re-training. To evaluate how effectively these metrics leverage underlying backbone improvements, we conduct what is, to our knowledge, the first study assessing them across eleven backbones from three model families and five benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 已经出现了两类评估器。 微调指标从偏好数据中学习评分函数（Xu et al., 2023 ; Kirstain et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Marjit et al., 2026），而无需训练的指标则通过提示一个现成的VLM实现（Lin et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2023 ; Cho et al., 2024）。 我们重点关注无需训练的一类指标，因为它具备一项根本性的结构优势：尽管微调评估器仍受限于特定架构及其训练数据的静态分布，但无需训练的指标能够自然地随基础模型一同扩展，继承主干模型的技术进步，而无需针对具体任务进行重新训练。 为了评估这些指标在多大程度上有效利用了底层主干模型的改进，我们开展了据我们所知的首项研究，在来自三个模型家族的十一个主干模型和五个基准测试中对其进行了全面评估。

paragraphs.en: Within the training-free family, two approaches have developed separately. Holistic scoring started with global embedding similarity between separately encoded text and image ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) and newer approaches ask VLMs a single question about the whole caption and read the probability of yes ( Lin et al. (2024) ; Figure 1 a). Decomposed scoring methods generate a set of verification questions from the caption, answer each against the image, and aggregate the results to obtain a final score ( Hu et al. (2023) ; Cho et al. (2024) ; Kamath et al. (2025) ; Figure 1 b). Holistic scoring preserves macro context and decomposed metrics offer fine-grained interpretability, but neither approach dominates across benchmarks. Decomposed metrics also share a flaw in how each answer is scored. The original TIFA scheme graded each question by string-matching the VLM’s answer against a label derived from the caption, such as objects, counts, or actions ( Hu et al., 2023 ) . Later methods simplified this by assuming a constant yes target, scored either by hard string matches ( Cho et al., 2024 ) or their probabilities ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) . We call this the fixed-yes assumption : the expected answer is fixed before looking at the image, so whenever it is wrong, the metric fails with it.
paragraphs.zh: 在无训练方法这一类别中，两种方法已各自独立发展。 整体评分法最初基于分别编码的文本与图像之间的全局嵌入相似度（Hessel 等，2021），而较新的方法则向视觉语言模型（VLM）提出一个关于整个描述句的单一问题，并读取“是”的概率（Lin 等（2024）；图 1a）。 分解评分法会从描述句中生成一系列验证问题，针对每个问题与图像进行比对作答，然后将结果汇总以获得最终得分（Hu 等（2023）；Cho 等（2024）；Kamath 等（2025）；图 1b）。 整体评分法保留了宏观上下文，而分解指标则提供了更精细的可解释性，但这两种方法在各项基准测试中均无绝对优势。 分解指标在单个答案的评分方式上也存在一个缺陷。 最初的 TIFA 方案通过字符串匹配 VLM 的答案与从描述句中提取的标签（如物体、数量或动作）来为每个问题打分（Hu 等，2023）。 后续方法对此进行了简化，假设目标答案恒为“是”，并通过严格的字符串匹配（Cho 等，2024）或其概率值（Kamath 等，2025）进行评分。 我们将其称为“固定‘是’假设”：即在查看图像之前，预期答案就已经确定；因此，只要该答案错误，指标就会随之失效。

paragraphs.en: We propose Depict , a training-free alignment metric (Figure 1 c). Given a caption, Depict decomposes the description into a set of visual assertions without requiring ground-truth labels. A VLM evaluates each assertion twice, once against the image and once against the caption alone, assigning a verdict to each. The score reflects the agreement between the two channels, which is high whenever both favor the same truth value, regardless of polarity. We further find that the holistic and decomposed paradigms are complementary rather than competing and Depict is the first metric to merge them. Across every human-judgment benchmark we test, the merged score correlates better with human ratings than either approach alone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Depict，一种无需训练的对齐度量（图 1c）。 给定一个描述文本，Depict 可将该描述分解为一组视觉断言，而无需真实标签。 视觉语言模型会对每个断言进行两次评估：一次基于图像，一次仅基于描述文本，并为每个断言给出判断结果。 该分数反映了两个评估通道之间的一致性；无论极性如何，只要两者都倾向于相同的真值，一致性就会很高。 我们进一步发现，整体与分解两种范式是互补而非相互竞争的，而 Depict 是首个将二者融合的度量方法。 在我们测试的所有人类判断基准中，融合后的分数都比单独使用任一方法更能与人类评分保持良好相关性。

paragraphs.en: Early alignment metrics like CLIPScore ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) and BLIP2Score ( Li et al., 2023 ) rely on global image-text similarity. paragraphs.en: These metrics query an off-the-shelf VLM ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2026 ) , so any stronger backbone can be swapped in at no cost. Early approaches decomposed the caption into a question per assertion ( Yarom et al., 2023 ; Singh and Zheng, 2023 ) and checked the image’s answer against a reference (a caption-derived label in TIFA ( Hu et al., 2023 ) or a fixed yes in DSG ( Cho et al., 2024 ) ). Soft scoring then replaced exact matching. VQAScore ( Lin et al., 2024 ) evaluated the entire caption by reading the probability of a single yes , capturing overall context but remaining blind to fine-grained details. Meanwhile, Gecko ( Wiles et al., 2025 ) and Soft-TIFA ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) read per-question answer probabilities, making decomposed scores continuous while retaining the fixed reference. Depict replaces this static reference with the agreement between a text and a visual answer and is the first to merge the decomposed and holistic approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 这些指标查询了一个现成的 VLM（Yang et al., 2025；Team et al., 2026），因此任何更强大的基础模型都可以无缝替换。 早期的方法将图像说明分解为每个断言对应一个问题（Yarom et al., 2023；Singh and Zheng, 2023），并将图像的คำตอบ与参考答案进行比较（在 TIFA（Hu et al., 2023）中，参考答案是源自图像说明的标签；在 DSG（Cho et al., 2024）中，则是一个固定的“是”）。 随后，软评分取代了精确匹配。 VQAScore（Lin et al., 2024）通过读取单个“是”的概率来评估整个图像说明，从而捕捉整体语境，但无法识别精细细节。 与此同时，Gecko（Wiles et al., 2025）和 Soft-TIFA（Kamath et al., 2025）则读取每个问题的答案概率，使分解后的评分变为连续值，同时保留了固定的参考答案。 Depict 用文本答案与视觉答案之间的一致性取代了这种静态参考，并且是首个将分解方法与整体方法相结合的方法。

paragraphs.en: We present Depict , a training-free metric that scores an image I I against a caption t t . Rather than scoring each question against a fixed answer as prior decomposed metrics do ( Hu et al., 2023 ; Cho et al., 2024 ) , Depict treats the answer y ∈ { yes , no } y\in\{\textsc{yes},\textsc{no}\} as a latent variable. It generates questions directly from the caption, answers each from the image and from the caption alone, and scores a question by the probability that the two answers coincide, marginalized over both outcomes. Questions are then weighted by how decisively the caption settles them, and the resulting decomposed score is merged with a holistic one (Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Depict，一种无需训练的评估指标，用于根据图像 I 和描述 t 对图像进行评分。 与以往的分解式指标（Hu et al., 2023; Cho et al., 2024）不同，后者将每个问题与固定答案进行评分，而 Depict 则将答案 y ∈ {yes, no} 视为一个潜在变量。 该指标直接从描述中生成问题，分别根据图像和仅根据描述回答每个问题，并通过两个答案一致的概率（对两种结果进行边缘化）来评估问题。 随后，问题会根据描述对其判断的明确程度进行加权，最终将分解后的得分与整体得分合并（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: DSG ( Cho et al., 2024 ) first parses t t into semantic tuples and then converts each tuple into a question. We skip the intermediate parsing step by prompting a language model to produce N N yes/no questions { q k } k = 1 N \{q_{k}\}_{k=1}^{N} directly from t t , each targeting a single verifiable detail and answerable from the image alone. Unlike DSG, the generator sees the whole caption, so questions do not inherit possible parsing errors and retain the context that tuple extraction discards, making post-hoc filtering and a dependency graph unnecessary. We ablate this in Section 5.5 .

paragraphs.en: Current soft metrics ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Kamath et al., 2025 ) rely on Faith , measuring only the visual channel’s probability of answering yes as in equation 1 . Confirm replaces the fixed reference with a soft text channel, p k t = p ⁡ ( yes ∣ t , q k ) p^{t}_{k}=p(\textsc{yes}\mid t,q_{k}) , in which the model answers the same question from the caption instead of the image (Eq. 2 ). This is the continuous version of a text-derived reference y k ∗ y_{k}^{*} where the visual score is weighted by how strongly the caption entails yes ( Hu et al., 2023 ) . However, because Confirm only rewards positive agreement, it fails whenever the correct answer is no . Agree resolves this by incorporating no probabilities ( p ¯ k v , p ¯ k t \bar{p}^{v}_{k},\bar{p}^{t}_{k} ) and marginalizing over the latent answer as a k = ∑ y p ⁡ ( y ∣ t , q k ) ​ p ​ ( y ∣ I , q k ) = p k t ​ p k v + p ¯ k t ​ p ¯ k v a_{k}=\sum_{y}p(y\mid t,q_{k})\,p(y\mid I,q_{k})=p^{t}_{k}p^{v}_{k}+\bar{p}^{t}_{k}\bar{p}^{v}_{k} (Eq. 3 ). It is symmetric across modalities and generalizes prior rules, reducing to hard discrete matching for one-hot outputs, to Faith when p k t = 1 p^{t}_{k}{=}1 , and to Confirm when omitting the no term.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的软指标（Lin et al., 2024；Kamath et al., 2025）依赖于 Faith，仅测量视觉通道回答“是”的概率，如方程 1 所示。 Confirm 用软文本通道取代了固定参考，即 p_k^t = p(\textsc{yes}\mid t,q_k)，其中模型根据图注而非图像来回答相同的问题（方程 2）。 这是基于文本的参考 y_k^* 的连续版本，其中视觉得分由图注在多大程度上蕴含“是”来进行加权（Hu et al., 2023）。 然而，由于 Confirm 仅奖励正向匹配，因此当正确答案为“否”时便会失效。 Agree 通过引入“否”的概率（\bar{p}^{v}_{k}, \bar{p}^{t}_{k}），并对潜在答案进行边缘化来解决这一问题：a_k = \sum_{y}p(y\mid t,q_k)\,p(y\mid I,q_k) = p^{t}_{k}p^{v}_{k}+\bar{p}^{t}_{k}\bar{p}^{v}_{k}（方程 3）。 该方法在模态间具有对称性，并能推广先前的规则：当 p_k^t = 1 时，退化为硬离散匹配；当省略“否”项时，则退化为 Faith。

paragraphs.en: We compare against three groups of metrics. 1) Training-free, embedding-similarity metrics score the cosine similarity of caption and image embeddings from a contrastive encoder: CLIPScore ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) and BLIPv2Score ( Li et al., 2023 ) . 2) Training-free, VLM-based metrics prompt an off-the-shelf VLM and run on any backbone; these are the focus of our analysis, and we take one representative per cell of the decomposition × \times granularity grid of Section 5.2 : DSG ( Cho et al., 2024 ) (decomposed, discrete), Soft-TIFA ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) (decomposed, continuous; the Faith rule of Eq. 1 ), and VQAScore ( Lin et al., 2024 ) (holistic, continuous). 3) Fine-tuned evaluators learn a scoring function from preference data or teacher annotations and are tied to their training backbone: ImageReward ( Xu et al., 2023 ) , PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) , UniGenBench++ ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , LongT2IBench ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , T2I-Eval ( Tu et al., 2025 ) , FGA-BLIP2 ( Han et al., 2024 ) , and DynEval ( Marjit et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们与三组指标进行了比较。1) 无需训练、基于嵌入相似性的指标，通过对比编码器计算图像与文本嵌入的余弦相似度：CLIPScore（Hessel 等，2021）和 BLIPv2Score（Li 等，2023）。2) 无需训练、基于 VLM 的指标，这些指标会提示一个现成的 VLM 并在任何骨干网络上运行；它们是我们分析的重点，我们从第 5.2 节中分解 × \times 粒度网格的每个单元格中选取了一个代表：DSG（Cho 等，2024）（分解式、离散型）、Soft-TIFA（Kamath 等，2025）（分解式、连续型；公式 1 中的 Faith 规则）以及 VQAScore（Lin 等，2024）（整体型、连续型）。3) 经过微调的评估器从偏好数据或教师标注中学习评分函数，并与它们所训练的骨干网络绑定：ImageReward（Xu 等，2023）、PickScore（Kirstain 等，2023）、UniGenBench++（Wang 等，2026）、LongT2IBench（Yang 等，2026）、T2I-Eval（Tu 等，2025）、FGA-BLIP2（Han 等，2024）以及 DynEval（Marjit 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: To decouple the scoring procedure from visual reasoning capability, all training-free methods are run on eleven backbones varying along four axes: 1) family , via Qwen3.5 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , InternVL3.5 ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and Gemma-4 ( Team et al., 2026 ) ; 2) scale , via two size ladders (Qwen3.5 4B/9B/27B, InternVL3.5 4B/8B/14B); 3) generation , via Qwen3.5/3.6/3.8 at a fixed 27B; and 4) architecture , via the Gemma-4 variants (per-layer embedding E4B, unified multimodal 12B, dense 31B). Qwen3-VL-4B provides a matched comparison against DynEval.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Depict against fine-tuned and training-free baselines across human alignment, compositional discrimination, and explicit negation. Across five benchmarks and eleven backbones, we show that expected agreement and term merging match or exceed fine-tuned evaluators, hold across backbones, and avoid failures of fixed- yes metrics. Qualitative evaluation is provided in Appendix E .

paragraphs.en: On Winoground’s short compositional captions, the decomposed term adds little beyond what the holistic pass captures, keeping Depict within the confidence interval of VQAScore across all three accuracies (Table 2 ). Furthermore, soft logit scoring across both terms ( Agree ) drives performance far more than decomposition itself, leaving discrete one-hot approaches like DSG lagging by 20 points.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Winoground 的简短组合式描述中，分解后的术语几乎没有超出整体处理所能捕捉的内容，使得 Depict 在所有三种准确率下都保持在 VQAScore 的置信区间内（表 2）。 此外，对两个术语（Agree）进行软逻辑评分比分解本身更能显著提升性能，而像 DSG 这样的离散独热方法则落后了 20 分。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we analyze how Agreement overcomes the structural flaws of fixed- yes rules on negation, while merging recovers performance on contested samples where terms disagree.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们分析了“一致”机制如何克服否定词固定“是”规则的结构缺陷，同时“合并”机制又如何恢复了在术语存在分歧的争议样本上的性能。

paragraphs.en: By reading the expected answer from the caption, Depict is the only decomposed metric accurate across all three templates (Fig. 3 a), while DSG and Soft-TIFA lose 85 85 – 95 % 95\% of their accuracy on negated items and fall below chance. This occurs because 87 % 87\% of questions for negated captions and 47 % 47\% for hybrid ones expect no vs 4 % 4\% elsewhere (Appendix D.1 ), so a fixed- yes rule gives a low score to every correct no before looking at the image, penalizing faithful images (Appendix B.2 - B.3 ; text reference reliability in Appendix D.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 通过阅读图注中的预期答案可以发现，Depict 是唯一在所有三种模板中分解指标均准确的模型（图 3a），而 DSG 和 Soft-TIFA 在否定项上的准确率损失了 85%–95%，甚至低于随机猜测水平。 这是因为，对于否定性图注的问题，有 87% 的预期答案为“否”，而对于混合图注的问题，这一比例为 47%，相比之下其他情况中“否”的比例仅为 4%（附录 D.1）。因此，采用固定的“是”规则会在查看图像之前就给所有正确的“否”答案打低分，从而对忠实反映内容的图像造成惩罚（附录 B.2–B.3；文本参考可靠性见附录 D.2）。

paragraphs.en: Agreement alone lifts both NegBench accuracy and human correlation over Faith but trails VQAScore on correlation; merging both terms places Depict ahead on both (Fig. 3 b). The merge of both terms (Eq. 7 ) works because the terms fail on different samples: on GenAI-Bench they disagree on 19 % 19\% of item pairs. Fig. 3 c shows that Depict tracks the results where both terms agree and it follows whichever term separates the two images more strongly where they disagree. Depict keeps 65 % 65\% of the pairs only the holistic term orders correctly and 54 % 54\% of those only the decomposed term does. Whereas individual terms fail on each other’s exclusive wins, Depict achieves 60 % 60\% accuracy across contested pairs, easily outperforming the holistic ( 53 % 53\% ) and decomposed ( 47 % 47\% ) terms alone. The merge relies on agreement: combining VQAScore with Soft-TIFA instead leaves GenAI-Bench unchanged and lowers NegBench to 62.2 62.2 , below VQAScore alone, since the fixed- yes term drags down the holistic score on negated items (Appendix C.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 仅使用 Agreement 可以在 NegBench 准确率和人类相关性方面超越 Faith，但在相关性上仍落后于 VQAScore；将两个术语合并后，Depict 在两项指标上均领先（图 3b）。 将两个术语合并（公式 7）之所以有效，是因为它们在不同的样本上表现不佳：在 GenAI-Bench 中，它们对 19% 19\% 的项目对存在分歧。 图 3c 显示，在两个术语一致的结果中，Depict 能够追踪这些结果；而在它们不一致时，Depict 则遵循能更显著区分两张图像的术语。 Depict 保留了 65% 65\% 仅由整体性术语正确排序的项目对，以及 54% 54\% 仅由分解性术语正确排序的项目对。 尽管单个术语在各自独有的成功案例中表现不佳，但 Depict 在所有存在争议的项目对中实现了 60% 60\% 的准确率，轻松超越了单独使用整体性术语（53% 53\%）和分解性术语（47% 47\%）的效果。 这种合并依赖于一致性：若将 VQAScore 与 Soft-TIFA 结合，则 GenAI-Bench 的结果保持不变，而 NegBench 会降至 62.2 62.2，低于单独使用 VQAScore 的结果，因为固定“是”的术语会在否定项上拉低整体性得分（附录 C.3）。

paragraphs.en: Along the Qwen3.5 ladder, Depict leads or ties at every size on all three correlation benchmarks, where larger backbones mainly narrow the gap for the weaker decomposed baselines. paragraphs.en: Fine-tuned, holistic, and decomposed metrics each capture distinct part of caption-image alignment: fine-tuning aligns with human judgments but ties the evaluator to one backbone; holistic VQA preserves global context but misses fine-grained errors; and standard decomposition uncovers compositional logic but relies on a fixed- yes target that breaks on negated captions. Depict resolves these trade-offs without training by evaluating two-sided answer agreement weighted by caption commitment, merged with a holistic VQA pass. Agreement lifts NegBench accuracy from 19 % 19\% to 88 % 88\% , and the merged score matches or exceeds top evaluators across five benchmarks and eleven backbones. On DynEval’s matched Qwen3-VL-4B backbone, Depict beats DynEval-4B on GenAI-Bench ( 0.630 0.630 vs. 0.595 0.595 SRCC) and RichHF ( 0.607 0.607 vs. 0.546 0.546 ), though fine-tuning retains a lead on TIFA160 ( 0.802 0.802 vs. 0.691 0.691 ).
paragraphs.zh: 经过微调、整体性和分解性的指标各自捕捉了图像与描述对齐的不同方面：微调与人判断一致，但将评估器绑定到单一骨干模型；整体性 VQA 保留了全局上下文，却忽略了细节错误；而标准的分解方法虽然能揭示组合逻辑，但却依赖一个固定的“是”目标，在否定性描述中会失效。 Depict 无需训练即可解决这些权衡问题，它通过评估基于描述承诺加权的两侧答案一致性，并将其与一次整体性 VQA 流程合并。 一致性指标将 NegBench 的准确率从 19% 19\% 提升至 88% 88\%，而合并后的分数在五个基准和十一个骨干模型上均达到或超过了顶尖评估器。 在 DynEval 匹配的 Qwen3-VL-4B 骨干模型上，Depict 在 GenAI-Bench（0.630 0.630 vs. 0.595 0.595 SRCC）和 RichHF（0.607 0.607 vs. 0.546 0.546）上优于 DynEval-4B，尽管在 TIFA160 上微调仍保持领先（0.802 0.802 vs. 0.691 0.691）。

paragraphs.en: Limitations remain: decomposition brings no gain on short prompts that hinge on compositional word order, such as Winoground, although enabling reasoning on answers improves results there; and because both channels share one backbone, a prior shared by both can make the same hallucination look like agreement. Answering each channel with a different backbone would decouple these priors, at the cost of hosting two models.

paragraphs.en: Winoground ( Thrush et al., 2022 ) contains 400 400 examples of two images and two captions that use the same words in a different order; a metric is correct on the text task if it scores each image higher with its own caption, on the image task if it scores each caption higher with its own image, and on the group task if both hold. NegBench ( Alhamoud et al., 2025 ) (COCO-MCQ split) pairs each of 5,914 5{,}914 COCO val2017 images with four candidate captions built from three templates: affirmative ( “a kitchen with a table” ), negation ( “a kitchen with no people” ), and hybrid, which combines both. One caption is correct and three are distractors; we score each image–caption pair independently and predict the highest-scoring caption, so chance is 25 % 25\% .
paragraphs.zh: Winoground (Thrush 等，2022) 包含 400 个示例，每个示例由两张图像和两个使用相同词语但顺序不同的描述组成；在文本任务中，若模型对每张图像与其对应的描述给出更高得分，则指标视为正确；在图像任务中，若模型对每个描述与其对应的图像给出更高得分，则指标视为正确；在组合任务中，若上述两种情况均成立，则指标视为正确。 NegBench (Alhamoud 等，2025)（COCO-MCQ 分割）将 COCO val2017 中的 5,914 张图像分别与四个候选描述配对，这些描述基于三种模板构建：肯定式（“一个有桌子的厨房”）、否定式（“一个没有人的厨房”）以及结合两者内容的混合式。 其中一个描述是正确的，另外三个是干扰项；我们对每对图像–描述进行独立评分，并预测得分最高的描述，因此随机猜中的概率为 25%。

sents.en: NegBench ( Alhamoud et al., 2025 ) (COCO-MCQ split) pairs each of 5,914 5{,}914 COCO val2017 images with four candidate captions built from three templates: affirmative ( “a kitchen with a table” ), negation ( “a kitchen with no people” ), and hybrid, which combines both.

paragraphs.en: The gap between pass count and actual runtime exists because pass costs vary widely: Question Generation Bottleneck: Multi-token text generation for question synthesis dominates the overall runtime. Single-Token Passes: Depict ’s additional text-only answers and holistic visual pass only decode a single token each, introducing minimal computational overhead.

paragraphs.en: In Table 13 we ask whether the benefit of merging depends on the decomposed term, by merging VQAScore with Soft-TIFA-AM instead of with Agree , using the same 0.5 / 0.5 0.5/0.5 recipe. The two merges tie on TIFA160 and Winoground, and the Soft-TIFA merge is slightly higher on RichHF ( − 0.008 -0.008 , not significant). They separate where the scoring rule matters: on GenAI-Bench the Soft-TIFA merge does not improve on VQAScore alone ( 0.696 0.696 vs. 0.698 0.698 ), while Depict gains 0.024 0.024 over it, and on NegBench the Soft-TIFA merge drops to 62.2 62.2 , well below VQAScore alone ( 84.7 84.7 ), because the fixed- yes term pulls the holistic score down on exactly the negated items it gets wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 在表 13 中，我们通过将 VQAScore 与 Soft-TIFA-AM 合并（而非与 Agree 合并），并使用相同的 0.5 / 0.5 0.5/0.5 配方，来探究合并的收益是否取决于被分解的术语。 这两种合并方式在 TIFA160 和 Winoground 上的得分相同，而在 RichHF 上 Soft-TIFA 合并的得分略高（− 0.008 -0.008，不显著）。 它们在评分规则起作用的场景中存在差异：在 GenAI-Bench 上，Soft-TIFA 合并并未比单独使用 VQAScore 有提升（0.696 0.696 对比 0.698 0.698），而 Depict 的得分则比它高出 0.024 0.024；在 NegBench 上，Soft-TIFA 合并的得分降至 62.2 62.2，远低于单独使用 VQAScore 的结果（84.7 84.7），这是因为固定的“是”术语恰好在其答错的否定项上拉低了整体得分。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate enabling chain-of-thought reasoning in the answering step while holding the generated questions fixed (Table 14 ). Reasoning makes the model commit, pushing answer probabilities toward 0 0 or 1 1 . On GenAI-Bench and NegBench, which rank many candidates by score, this produces ties, and every reasoning variant scores at or below the reasoning-off row. Winoground, which compares only two captions per image, instead gains up to + 5.5 +5.5 group points, for two reasons. With reasoning, the holistic term less often rejects both captions of an image ( 18.5 % → 7.4 % 18.5\%\to 7.4\% of images), a case where the two low scores are nearly tied and their comparison unreliable. And with reasoning in the decomposed term, the two terms fail on more different examples (the correlation ϕ \phi between their per-example errors falls from 0.52 0.52 to 0.43 0.43 ), which leaves the merge more errors to correct. We keep reasoning off to preserve graded probability estimates and avoid the extra token cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在保持生成问题不变的前提下，评估在回答阶段启用链式思维推理的效果（表 14）。 推理使模型做出明确判断，将答案概率推向 0 或 1。 在 GenAI-Bench 和 NegBench 上，这两个基准通过分数对多个候选模型进行排名，这种做法会导致并列情况出现，且所有推理变体的得分都等于或低于关闭推理时的行数据。 Winoground 每张图片仅比较两个描述，因此反而获得了高达 +5.5 的组别加分，这有两个原因。 启用推理后，“整体性”这一术语较少地同时拒绝一张图片的两个描述（从 18.5% → 7.4% 的图片），这种情况中两个低分几乎并列，导致它们的比较不可靠。 而在分解术语中启用推理时，这两个术语在更多不同示例上出现错误（它们在每个示例上的错误相关性 ϕ 从 0.52 降至 0.43），这使得合并过程需要纠正更多错误。 我们保持推理关闭，以保留分级的概率估计并避免额外的标记成本。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 18 shows two failures, one per selection task, and the per-question scores expose the cause of each. On NegBench #2034 the negation is handled correctly, since the text channel expects no bottle for the correct caption, but the image channel wrongly sees a bottle ( p v ≈ 0.7 p^{v}\approx 0.7 ). This supports the distractor “This image features a bottle” and contradicts the correct “A bottle is not shown” , and because the holistic term makes the same perceptual error ( 0.41 0.41 against 0.15 0.15 ), Depict ranks the correct caption third of four ( 0.22 0.22 against 0.53 0.53 ). On GenAI-Bench #247, all methods prefer the Midjourney image, rated 4.0 4.0 by humans, over the DALL-E 3 image rated 5.0 5.0 . Both terms of Depict favour it: the holistic term scores it 0.95 0.95 against 0.69 0.69 , and in the decomposed term the two images differ mainly on whether the scroll is lit by the crystals, which the image channel affirms for Midjourney (agreement 0.98 0.98 ) but largely rejects for DALL-E 3 ( 0.35 0.35 ), while neither image is judged to show exactly two crystals. The two images are close in faithfulness, and the one-point gap in human ratings may reflect rating noise as much as a metric error.
paragraphs.zh: 图 18 显示了两种失败情况，每种选择任务各一种，而每道题的得分揭示了各自失败的原因。 在 NegBench #2034 中，否定关系得到了正确处理，因为文本通道期望正确描述中不会出现瓶子，但图像通道错误地识别出了瓶子（ p v ≈ 0.7 p^{v}\approx 0.7 ）。 这支持了干扰项“这张图片展示了一个瓶子”，而反驳了正确的描述“图片中没有显示瓶子”；由于整体性术语也犯了同样的感知错误（0.41 对 0.15），Depict 将正确描述在四个选项中排到了第三位（0.22 对 0.53）。 在 GenAI-Bench #247 中，所有方法都更倾向于 Midjourney 生成的图片（人类评分为 4.0），而非 DALL-E 3 生成的图片（评分为 5.0）。 Depict 的两个术语都更青睐 Midjourney 的图片：整体性术语的得分为 0.95（对比 0.69），而在分解术语中，两张图片的主要差异在于卷轴是否被水晶照亮——图像通道对 Midjourney 的图片确认了这一点（一致度 0.98），但对 DALL-E 3 的图片则基本否定了（0.35）；同时，两张图片都没有被判断为恰好展示了两个水晶。 这两张图片在忠实度上非常接近，人类评分中的一点差距可能反映了评分噪声，而不仅仅是指标误差。
